_example._help: Entries in "sites" tell the TV how to read one index page. Only host and item are required; everything else is optional and falls back to automatic reading. All selectors are CSS selectors. "item" matches every event row; the others are looked up INSIDE each row, except "section" (headings of date groups, anywhere on the page: the nearest one above the row is used). "host" also matches its subdomains. "zone" (optional, e.g. "UTC" or "Europe/London") is the time zone for times the page writes without a zone label; an entry may hold only "host" and "zone", and its rows are then read automatically. "habit" (optional) is what to do on this site's stream pages right after they load: copy the "Habit for recipes.json:" line from a What happened? report into "sites" as it is (tap x/y are fractions of the hidden browser, button counts from 1). A habit learned on the TV wins; the shipped one is used when there is none. Copy this object into "sites" and fill it in.
